tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Main conversation canvas and page background (HIG systemBackground). Light from ref 2 Parchment, dark from ref 1 Void.

tokens.name: bg-sidebar
tokens.usage: Left sidebar (vault list, chat history) and right study panel; recedes behind the transcript (HIG secondarySystemBackground).

tokens.name: bg-grouped
tokens.usage: Grouped-list backgrounds in Settings — the inset table that holds bg-elevated rows (HIG grouped background).

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dialogs, sheets, grouped rows, cards — always with separator border plus shadow-popover.

tokens.name: fill-control
tokens.usage: Resting fill of the chat composer, text fields, segmented controls. Dark is ref 1 Carbon.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover veil on ghost buttons, sidebar rows and list rows (ref 5 Hover Veil).

tokens.name: fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state and the selected sidebar row.

tokens.name: bubble-user
tokens.usage: Fill of the user's own message bubble. Assistant replies have no bubble — plain text on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons: headings, transcript, button labels on neutral fills. 16:1+ on every bg-* in both themes.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, source paths, helper copy, inactive sidebar items. ≥5.5:1 on bg-canvas, bg-sidebar, fill-control.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels ONLY (HIG tertiaryLabel). ~4:1 on fill-control light, 3.7:1 on Carbon dark — never for readable content.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline: sidebar edge, card and popover borders, list dividers (refs 1 and 5).

tokens.name: separator-strong
tokens.usage: Section dividers, table heads, the composer's resting outline.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of checkboxes, radio buttons, unfilled switches and text-field focus edge — meets 3:1 non-text contrast.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one tint (HIG accent color), saffron (ref 3 Amrit Palace Saffron Glow): primary button fill, send orb, active tab, progress, switch on. Dark is the source saffron #d49653; light is deepened so the fill meets 3:1 against bg-canvas.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on accent fills — one step lighter in both themes so on-accent keeps its contrast.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent fill: dark ink in BOTH themes (5.2:1 light, 8.3:1 dark). Saffron is too light for white text (2.5–3.3:1) — never put white on accent.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Saffron as text or icon on neutral grounds: links, citation numbers, 'Kaynaklar' toggle. 5.3:1+ on bg-canvas, bg-sidebar and fill-control in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind a highlighted source chip or the cited note in the source tree; text on it stays label.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset, on every interactive element. ≥3:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (Sil), error messages. HIG high-contrast red; always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed indexing, correct quiz answer — always with a check icon or 'Doğru'.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Stale index, local server offline — always with an icon and text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral informational notices (HIG high-contrast blue); never a second brand accent.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop behind dialogs and sheets (ref 5 Deep Charcoal, lighter in light).

tokens.name: material-bar
tokens.usage: Translucent toolbar / title bar over scrolling content, combined with backdrop material-blur (HIG material).

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Empty chat state and welcome only — one per screen (ref 1 section-display).

styles.name: display-title
styles.usage: Page title of top-level pages (Library, Study, Settings) — HIG Large Title size set in Gambetta.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Section titles inside a page; markdown h2 in answers.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Panel and sheet titles; markdown h3.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles, card titles, emphasized list items.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI body: dialogs, settings descriptions.

styles.name: body-reading
styles.sample: Sayfalama, belleği eşit büyüklükte çerçevelere böler ve her sürece bir sayfa tablosu verir.
styles.usage: Chat transcript and long-form answers; measure capped at 68ch.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Composer text, input fields, quiz answer options.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: Sidebar rows, button labels, menu items, segmented controls.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Metadata, source chips, timestamps, helper text under fields.

styles.name: caption-1
styles.usage: Section headers in sidebar lists (uppercase allowed), badges.

styles.name: caption-2
styles.usage: Smallest permitted text: model tags, keyboard hints. Never below 11px.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code in answers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; HIG base grid unit.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding (vertical 10–12), button horizontal inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and popover padding; side gutter at narrow widths.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sidebar horizontal inset, composer inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between message turns and between page sections (ref 5 section gap).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top padding, gap above a display title.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Empty-state breathing room around display-hero (ref 1 spacing-56).

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: HIG minimum hit target for touch layouts; on pointer desktop no control is smaller than 28px tall, icon buttons 32px.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Left sidebar width (ref 5: 260–280).

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Right study panel width.

tokens.name: reading-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the transcript column and composer (ref 5: 720–768).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, inline code, badges, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, sidebar rows, menu items (ref 5 10px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, menus, the user bubble.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Chat composer and dialogs/sheets (ref 1 large panel radius, softened).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Send orb, filter chips, source chips, switches.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips — the only floating elements that cast a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets over the scrim.

tokens.name: shadow-composer
tokens.usage: Resting composer edge — a hairline, not elevation (ref 1 Hero Prompt Composer).

backdrop.note: HIG materials: translucent bars that blur content scrolling beneath.

tokens.name: material-blur
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of title bar / toolbar with material-bar fill.

duration.note: Motion timing; easing is in the README.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, exits.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Popover, sheet and panel reveals.
